# Multi Thumb Slider

Adjust several ordered values on one shared numeric track.

## Examples

### Two thumb range

Use two thumbs to choose the lower and upper bounds of an interval.

<ComponentExample component="multi-thumb-slider" scenario="two-thumb-range" title="Two thumb range" description="Use two thumbs to choose the lower and upper bounds of an interval." :index="0" />

### Three thumb thresholds

Use three thumbs to divide one numeric range into meaningful thresholds.

<ComponentExample component="multi-thumb-slider" scenario="three-thumb-thresholds" title="Three thumb thresholds" description="Use three thumbs to divide one numeric range into meaningful thresholds." :index="1" />

### Crossing thumbs

Prevent or normalize thumb crossing according to the configured range policy.

<ComponentExample component="multi-thumb-slider" scenario="crossing-thumbs" title="Crossing thumbs" description="Prevent or normalize thumb crossing according to the configured range policy." :index="2" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> | Increase the value by one step. |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Decrease the value by one step. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the minimum or maximum value. |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Change the value by the configured page step when supported. |

## Accessibility

Every thumb is separately named and exposes its own minimum, maximum, current value, and orientation.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/slider-multithumb/) for the host accessibility contract.
